LanguageData.LP_BoneTalisman.label: bone amulet
LanguageData.LP_BoneTalisman.description: An amulet strung from bone shards and human leather by a lich. Enemy necromantic constructs won't attack the wearer on their own; if the wearer attacks a construct first, they fight back as usual. Worn in the accessory slot, taking no other gear slot. Only liches can make it at the necromantic ritual table.
